newsitem.title: FINLAND: AHLSTROM SAYS CAN MAINTAIN 96 OP EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: AHLSTROM SAYS CAN MAINTAIN 96 OP EARNINGS.

text.p: Finnish privately owned paper and engineering group A. Ahlstrom Oy said on Tuesday it could probably maintain operating earnings at the 1996 level, which it reported at 904 million markka, up from 839 million in 1995.
"The level of operational earnings achieved in 1996 can probably be maintained," the company said in a statement.

Under the headline, "a favourable outlook for 1997," the statement said its aggregate net sales were expected to rise to 15 billion markka in 1997 (from 11.8 billion in 1996), with the paper group accounting for almost half that figure.
